chunks: O men, We created you from a male and female, and formed you into nations and tribes that you may recognise each other. He who has more integrity has indeed greater honour with God. Surely God is all-knowing and well-informed.

key_terms.لِتَعَارَفُوا: that you may recognize each other

ai.seo_question: What is the basis of human nobility in Islam according to Surah Al-Hujurat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to refute tribal arrogance (asabiyah) and establish that spiritual merit supersedes genealogical pride, a theme central to the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings. The phrase 'for you to know one another' (li-ta'arafu) implies active engagement and mutual respect among diverse communities, reinforcing social cohesion under divine guidance. This principle underscores the Islamic ideal of equality before God, where taqwa serves as the sole criterion for honor.
